entry.title: New: Resolution 517 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACQUISITION OF PRIVATE PROPERTY BY EMINENT DOMAIN OF TAX MAP KEY: 8-6-008:011, SITUATED AT WAIEA, DISTRICT OF SOUTH KONA, COUNTY AND STATE OF HAWAIʻI, FOR CONTINUED USE OF THE WAIEA RECYCLING AND TRANSFER STATION BY THE SOLID WASTE DIVISION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT

The County seeks to acquire approximately 2.282 acres of land to continue to operate the Waiea Convenience Center, also known as the Waiea Recycling and Transfer Station.

Latest action: Council: Res. 517-24, Draft 3, passes second & final reading - 06/19/2024
